notes_for_editor: Only tower-specific source is tnlandforms.us, a personal list last revised March 2016. Its names for towers 73 and up are the author's own, so the name may not be official. Group membership is inferred from list numbers: the name style changes from GA072 (title case) to GA073 (lowercase), matching the 73 split. The brief's registers entries (BLL and GFC codes) are row codes from that list, not NHLR or FFLOS entries. The usgs tag also appears on rows numbered 73 and up (e.g. GA273 candler), so it does not mark a USGS name; the page does not define it in the passages read. Absence from the NHLR and FFLOS lists comes from reading their Georgia pages. Two searches run; no build, staffing, fire or fate source found. No status, access or visit facts supported.
